items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tio. Tio. Charlie Bogaj playing banjo.

ctx.x: In the old days, you'd have Peter Bogaj. Peter Bogaj.
Tio. Tio. Charlie Bogaj playing banjo. Albert Oney Grand Alto, saxophone.
There's a picture. Several pictures of that band has been printed. Some of them have been printed.
